source: Maintainer-curated English conventional names (exonyms) and common romanizations that are not printed in the pinned UN/LOCODE entry for the same port. UN/LOCODE parenthetical names (e.g. 'Mumbai (ex Bombay)') are read from the gazetteer itself and are not repeated here.
policy: Each alias must point to a port-function LOCODE in ports-gazetteer.json (enforced by unit test). An alias adds a candidate; it never removes another same-name location, so collisions produce ambiguity instead of a forced identity.
